items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: he and I was, used to play guitar together and banjo.

ctx.x: And, uh, I think Percy's, he's playing, uh, he's playing piano now. But he was, well, he was stringing instrument all the way around because he, from guitar to banjo, and, uh, he tried to play bass a little, but now he's strictly, he's, he's playing piano. Playing piano now together. I thought that, uh, I was thinking that they'd be up here, I think one, one night next week, if I'm not mistaken. But, uh, you could, uh, go up on Franklin Street, uh, a boy works in the Savoy Grill by the name of, uh, Daley. And…
Well, you were in the fire itself.
